subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a property of graphite?

options.text: It is a conductor of electricity.
It has a lower density than diamond.
It is a conductor of heat.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It has low melting point.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Graphite is an allotrope of carbon.
 
• **It is a conductor of heat and electricity.**
 
• **It has a lower density than diamond.**
 
• Graphite is used as a lubricant in high temperatures.
 
• Because it has a high melting point.
 
• Hence statement 4 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In graphite single carbon atom is bonded with the other three carbon atoms.
 
• So it looks like a sheet in a three-dimensional figure.
 
• Between the sheets, weak forces are there.
 
• It has hexagonal rings of strongly bonded carbon atoms while weak interplate bonds.
 
• So it is a soft solid and uses as a lubricant.
